The same man who then, after being abanonded by the NUS government at war's end, built from that foothold a new homeland for himself, all financed by smuggling and arms deals on a global scale.

To some, he's a glorified gangster and war profiteer, to others – a deserter and terrorist. To others still, he's the charismatic leader of BARGHEST, the liberating force that keeps Dogtown free from NCPD jurisdiction and corporate influence and that has turned the derelict district into a new home for so many without one.

Kurt Hansen is a man of many faces. But if you ask Dogtown residents, most will say it's safer to keep your head down than to see any of them for yourself.

title: Alena "Alex" Xenakis
text:
Undercover FIA agent, metanthropic technology specialist and Solomon Reed's ex-protégé. Growing up in the slums of the Los Angeles Metroplex, she saw her parents drown in various addictions, her friends' childhoods plummet into a neverending cycle of crime, an environment riddled with inescapable poverty and a life of hopelessness... but she always dreamed of seeing herself on the braindance billboards. It was a stroke of luck that the BD studio that discovered her was an FIA front.
Soon, Alex was a fledgling agent under the wing of accomplished spy Solomon Reed, undertaking risky ops and classified missions - both domestic and foreign. When the Unification War broke out, she was sent to Night City, where things went south and Alex came full circle. She returned to the slums she so desperately wanted to leave, though this time it was Dogtown instead of LA. After seven years under cover doing routine spy work, she had almost lost hope of ever getting out of this hellhole... until an old friend suddenly appeared on her doorstep.

title: Wilky "Slider" Laguerre
text: A brilliant Voodoo Boy netrunner who was once the right hand of Maman Brigitte before they clashed over ideals. Brigitte dreamed of piercing the Blackwall, which led to constant skirmishes with NetWatch, while Slider preferred to stay away from grand schemes to focus on what he did best - carrying out corporate heists and assassinations via cyberspace. Unfortunately for him, one such heist caught the attention of FIA agents, who irreversibly deprived him of his sight, and then through blackmail and intimidation made him their informant. In an attempt to break free from the agency's chains, he fled Pacifica and joined his brothers in Dogtown, where he took control of an illegal software operation. As it turned out, the FIA's reach extended there as well.

title: Aurore Cassel
text: The more fiery half of the of the netrunner duo that go by the name of Skylight in cyberspace. Relatively wealthy by birth, formally educated, but perpetually insatiable, she craves adventure, excitement and unusual experiences, which first pushed her to work - then lock horns - with the French criminal organization known as the Collective. Along the way, there was some time done in the VIP wing of "La Santé" prison, work for Militech on the Cynosure project and, of course, the numerous hacking assignments she undertook with her twin brother on the side. Today, however, she's entertaining Kurt Hansen himself. And tomorrow? Maybe one of the fashion shows she so loves to attend? A visit to Tokyo, London, Paris? Or maybe another dangerous assignment for dangerous peeps? Who knows what tomorrow will bring...

title: Aymeric Cassel
text: The more phlegmatic half of the netrunner duo known as Skylight in cyberspace. An avid meditator, expensive car lover and preacher of what he calls "spiritual hygiene," but also a formally educated software engineer. He offered his services honestly and legally for a time, but very quickly realized that he would rather hack for organized crime and clandestine corporate operations rather than be just another quant for a European agency. The Cynosure project, part of Militech's Night City operations, was one of many assignments Aymeric was involved in, rarely working without his twin sister by his side. He recently returned to the City of Dreams at the personal invitation of Kurt Hansen. If you wanna do biz, do it with the big fish; the bigger, the better.

title: Albert Murphy
text: For the longest time, Murphy thought the most important thing was to find himself in the right place at the right time at least once - then life would be a breeze. Years spent living in Dogtown shattered this illusion. You had to stick with the right people, often break your back for them. Dogtown is a miniscule nation, but its atmosphere is tense - it needs an iron fist to keep the comers and goers in check. That fist belongs to Murphy. As a representative of Hansen's more approachable side, he'll talk to everyone who's anyone and sound them out. Depending on the need, or Hansen's mood, that talk can go smoothly, or it can end with a bullet in the other person's skull.

title: Yuri Bychkov
text:
Hansen's lieutenant and close comrade from the days of "Midnight Storm" - the operation to occupy Pacifica. Normally a loyal soldier, his reputation has recently taken a hit - he messed up big-time, started making deals behind Kurt's back... Subtlety is not his strong suit - he'd rather shoot all his problems than fix them.

After years of serving under Hansen, he's getting increasingly annoyed with being treated as an inferior. Either he proves himself through loyalty and resourcefulness... or through shrewdness and wile. As a gambling man, he couldn't choose anything but the latter.

title: Aguilar Nubiola
text:
The name of this assassin-for-hire who works for the Cuban cartel has become synonymous with bad news. It is said that every time someone in Havana lights a cigar, Aguilar extinguishes a life somewhere around the globe... all to secure the interests of her employers. In the criminal underworld, she has developed the reputation of the ultimate assassin: ruthless, incorruptible and brutally efficient. Sometimes she also acts as a negotiator, where even her mere presence can cool heated disputes. But should the one-woman diplomatic corps routine fail, bodies will begin to drop. As many as necessary.

Her legend has grown to the point that some Valentinos scare their misbehaving children with the warning: "If you don't quiet yourself, Aguilar will." Even if you only believe a fraction of the urban legends tied to her, the infamous assassin would still have dozens of high-profile victims to her name. Whether you're a gang leader, police commissioner, corp exec or politician, when you hear the name Aguilar, you run, you hide and you pray for mercy.

title: Chester Bennett
text: A heap of muscle and chrome bearing the rank of Lieutenant Colonel in BARGHEST. Bennett was Kurt Hansen's sidekick from the days when they both served in the army, where he stood out for his strength and determination on the battlefield, but also for his lack of discipline and sadism. He avoided jail time for his war crimes only because of Hansen's intervention - and only to him is Bennett unswervingly loyal. When the ashes of war settled over Pacifica in 2070, Bennett emerged as commander of the armed forces of the freshly-formed BARGHEST. He continues in that role to this day, inspiring respect mixed with fear among his subordinates. Obedient to Hansen, he never crosses the line without an explicit order, but his favorite pastime remains hanging people from lampposts.

title: Jago Szabó
text: If BARGHEST was a legitimate corporation, Jago would be its CFO and his name would be on platinum-coated business cards. For now, he has to settle for the unofficial position of the organization's "treasurer". He's a real numbers whisperer, a virtuoso accountant and the bane of stubborn contractors. Though he may seem the odd one out in a highly-militarized structure, Jago aims high and works diligently to achieve his goals. His friendly disposition is only a facade, behind which lies a cold, calculating intellect.

title: Charles Graham
text:
Personal bodyguard to Jago, member of BARGHEST and a man with an obscure past. On the surface, Charlie (as he's known to friends) appears to be the task-oriented type, a man of few words. Because of this, many assume his mental capacities have been dulled by years of excessive cyberware use, though this couldn't be farther from the truth.

Charlie has a passion for chess and German opera. Only a select few know that he spent his childhood on the streets of Vienna, dreaming of a career on the stage. However, his family's sudden bankruptcy forced him into a life of crime, eventually leading him to Dogtown.

Today, Charlie is one of Jago's most capable and trusted soldiers. Without him, Jago may have never climbed so high in his career.

title: Dante Caruso
text: Militech's undercover agent, a cyber-cowboy who hunts down individuals who threaten the corporation's interests, often operating under cover. Beneath the face of a cool professional is a man who simply wants to do the right thing. Dante knows it's easy to make a mistake when passing judgment alone, but he also knows it's safer to shoot one time too many than one time too few. He only manages to sleep soundly once the job is done. He doesn't particularly enjoy working for Militech, but every day he gets up, swallows the bitter pill and fits his iron in his holster; he knows that if he lets go, the world - his world - would probably collapse.

title: Bree Whitney
text:
A media for whom, until recently, writing for screamsheets was her bread and butter. But Bree always wanted something more from life. She finally stumbled across a serious story, and although it got red-hot, she decided not to let it go. Now she's rummaging through corp closets for skeletons - a lucrative commodity in Night City that could either earn you stacks, or more commonly a bullet to the head.
Bree is paranoid and stressed, but that's hardly surprising given the circumstances. She knows what she wants and intends to achieve it regardless of the price. She is secretive and careful with her words - saving them instead for her articles.

title: Lina Malina
text: The one and only Queen Bitch of Dogtown! An aspiring BD star who would pounce at the first chance of making it big. And if someone stands in her way of glory, she'll claw their face off. For now, her BDs are mainly circulating amongst the truly desperate BD junkies of Dogtown, but everyone starts somewhere, right? After all, difficult starts only make for extra drama in one's biography.

title: Lina & TooLina
text: Two batshit-crazy twins going on even crazier adventures - the duo Night City viewers deserved, but didn't know they needed. The two sisters' show brings content that would perk up even the most skullsponge-fried BD zombie, with weekly episodes packed to the brim with adrenaline and sheer absurdity.

title: Aaron Waines
text:
A talented young boxer, born and bred in Dogtown. Once part of the Animals gang, his Alpha implanted him with a chip to control him inside the ring and fix fights, reaping heaps of eddies.

Aaron is a demure, no-nonsense kid with a rekindled passion for boxing and in a position to seize an opportunity – an upcoming fight could change his career and let him finally break free from the gang's grip.

title: Angelica Whelan
text:
Cunning, witty and also the alpha of her pack in Dogtown. Unlike most Animals, she's not a hulking mountain of muscle. She earned the respect of her people through sheer charisma. It started with a simple negotiation that required a little more finesse than most Animals could muster, with both sides realizing they could benefit from mutual cooperation.

Since then Angie's been on top of biz, arranging and fixing fights and wheeling in cash. She's well aware of her position and knows just how far she can reach. The right woman for the job.

title: Damir Kovac
text:
A ripperdoc living in Dogtown. He left Night City after several clients accused him of undermining the performance of certain implants during standard procedures so that they would return for another visit. Trouble ensued.

He currently works for the scavs in Terra Cognita and sometimes takes jobs from Animals. Though he may seem like a decent-enough guy, he has a habit of sticking his nose where it doesn't belong, fueled by his neuroticism. Above all, he craves peace and quiet.

title: Paco Torres
text:
A BARGHEST rookie who squeezes every opportunity that presents itself to the last drop. Extreme confidence combined with the naivety of youth have led him to try turning every situation to his benefit. And after? Somehow things will always work themselves out.
Constantly on the move and full of "amazing" ideas, he fell into Hansen's bad graces almost immediately after joining BARGHEST. Since he acts first and thinks later, he likely won't learn much from his mistakes. If you're always one step away from a better situation, you have to take it, right? It's just logic.

title: Barbara "Babs" Okoye
text:
A BARGHEST soldier with several years of experience under her belt. Sensible, pragmatic, and most importantly - Paco's best choom. She has, in a way, assumed the role of his older sister and tries her hardest to keep him from getting himself killed. She accepts most things as they are, doesn't like to stick her neck out, preferring to move on and forget.
She landed in Dogtown after her ex framed her for dealing in infected BDs and promptly vanished. After that incident she'd rather glide through life in peace and without risk. But then... she met Paco.

title: Farida Nazeri
text:
Farida is not the typical doctors' daughter who simply followed in their footsteps. Even as a child, she understood that ideals mainly serve those who are - or strive to be - in power. When her mother was accused of murdering a member of Iran's elite on the operating table, the family was forced to flee the country. They found asylum in the NUSA, where Militech immediately took advantage of her parents' skills and prepared young Farida for her profession by tossing her headfirst into the Unification War as soon as her training was complete.

Farida ended up in Hansen's unit, which was sent to Night City. There she witnessed once again how power distorts ideals. Hansen, however, gave her a clinic and, in a way, a free hand. Now the ripper maintains the cyberware of BARGHEST soldiers and private clients alike while keeping her head down, hoping that once she saves up enough, she can walk away and maybe even return to Iran. In the meantime, as long as she has the option, she doesn't refuse to help her old contacts, for despite the many disappointments over the years, she still feels like an NUSA soldier.

title: Aguilar Nubiola
text:
The name of this assassin-for-hire who works for the Cuban cartel has become synonymous with bad news. It is said that every time someone in Havana lights a cigar, Aguilar extinguishes a life somewhere around the globe... all to secure the interests of his employers. In the criminal underworld, he has developed the reputation of the ultimate assassin: ruthless, incorruptible and brutally efficient. Sometimes he also acts as a negotiator, where even his mere presence can cool heated disputes. But should the one-man diplomatic corps routine fail, bodies will begin to drop. As many as necessary.

His legend has grown to the point that some Valentinos scare their misbehaving children with the warning: "If you don't quiet yourself, Aguilar will." Even if you only believe a fraction of the urban legends tied to him, the infamous assassin would still have dozens of high-profile victims to his name. Whether you're a gang leader, police commissioner, corp exec or politician, when you hear the name Aguilar, you run, you hide and you pray for mercy.

title: Space Force One
text: The SV I-12 Coda I has been the mainstay of Space Force One in recent years. Compared to the Griffin 414 President Kress flew on back in her day, this model is much lighter and faster. Based on Songbird's recommendations, Rosalind Myers put forward a number of requirements that the Coda had to meet in addition to the general safety standards for suborbital aircraft, and these are what probably led to so few casualties when SFO crashed in Dogtown. Above all, the reduction of the sizeable office area made it possible to comfortably accommodate the same number of NUSA agents as in a larger craft, while the office itself was reinforced with prototype shock-dampening fibers made by Militech. Last but not least, this is the first presidential aircraft equipped with combat bots and the first to have ever activated them.

title: Chimera
text:
The Chimera is a prototype tank designed for combat in difficult terrain, including urban areas. It was developed under the leadership of Militech armored division chief engineer Dr. Filippo Andrews. The project was created in response to the need for a "new heavy tank capable of sustained fire and prolonged engagement of enemy forces".

The design of the Chimera tank was developed between 2065 and 2069. The standard loadout includes a KL-274XYA flechette cannon, a PAN-12 Furia laser cannon, a GD27-Angstschema launcher with both surface-to-surface and surface-to-air capability (SSM/SAM), a combat gas atomizer, smoke screens and a sophisticated ICE cyberdefense system (TYA-12) to neutralize enemy netrunner hacks.

Although about thirteen Chimera units were produced, it never entered mass production. According to engineers from the rival Arasaka corporation, the Chimera wouldn't have proved a worthwhile investment due to the unit's apparent "vulnerability to attacks from above, hindering its performance in the urban arena for which it was designed."

The PAN-12 Furia laser cannon was designed to neutralize heavily armored ground and air targets. The cannon is capable of two modes:
1. Burst fire - short beams of plasma capable of causing temporary electrical disruption to hostiles;
2. Continuous fire - a powerful, high-energy beam capable of cutting through the latest in corporate armor technology.

The KL-274XYA flechette cannot is a fast-firing heavy turret (4,800 rounds per minute) that is most effective against organic and lightly armored units. The flechettes can also contain incendiary and explosive elements and the cannon is integrated with a thermal targeting system.

The Chimera's six legs provide excellent mobility and versatility in urban terrain, capable of climbing inclines of up to 87 degrees. The legs are reinforced with advanced ERA (explosive reactive armor), but should its legs sustain critical damage, it can still maintain near full mobility with only four. Each leg is also equipped with kinetic energy absorbers and energy recovery systems. Every step it takes generates approximately 31,000 Newtons of force.

title: Thorton Colby BARGHEST
text:
BARGHEST engineers treated the original Thorton Colby as a loose inspiration. They transformed the versatile car that millions of Americans have come to love into a paramilitary vehicle for special tasks, such as the ballistic steel panels incorporated into the design that can withstand regular machine gun fire.

The real secret of this car is its modified suspension, which guarantees the Colby BARGHEST confident handling in the most unpredictable situation or terrain. The tuned tires don't slip off the rim even when punctured, and the armored fuel tank is essentially bulletproof. CrystalDome technology allows for the discreet transport of "dubious" people and goods and the 280 horsepower engine allows for a smooth exit out of any danger zone. If it was possible to order a cab in Dogtown, everyone would want a vehicle like the Thorton Colby BARGHEST to come pick them up.

title: Mahir Supron BARGHEST
text: BARGHEST modded this van to the point of unrecognition, even to Mahir factory specialists. But necessity is the mother of invention, and even the Supron's designers' worst nightmares couldn't compare to Dogtown's roads. Potholes are one thing, but passersby armed to the teeth, landmines and improvised barricades are an altogether different can of worms. The model's facelift included pneumatic suspension, a 349 horsepower engine and armor impenetrable to most bullets and improvised explosive devices. The motto, "necessity over style" was perfectly embodied in the Supron BARGHEST's finesse-free body, but some things are important and others... important-er. Like surviving your next patrol through Dogtown.

title: Thorton Merrimac MSL3
text: If you ever dreamed of riding in a tank, the Merrimac MSL3 will make that dream come true! Sort of. Thorton is known for delivering on carrying capacity, but other models are like packs of chewing gum compared to the Merrimac. The increased rear load capacity achieved by two of the three axles allows loading equipment fit for a small army in the trunk. In addition, the Merrimac's reinforced body helps protect passengers from light — which is not to say harmless — gunfire. Thorton's standard hydropneumatic suspension, combined with six beefy wheels, gives the Merrimac MSL3 the green light to roll over any terrain.

title: Militech Hellhound
text: Militech may not be your first or second choice when it comes to car makers, but their armored vehicles are unparalleled. The Hellhound has been spiked with the corp's state-of-the-art technology like a needle-ridden voodoo doll. Getting inside this SUV feels like being inside an AV - getting out, too, as the side-sliding doors let you feel like you're exiting an AV mid-flight. A real military kick comes from the Hellhound's two gun ports, with the option of mounting a full-size turret or a missile launcher. The armored body is just the icing on the cake of a truly indestructible chassis, which dissipates explosive energy in the event of driving over a mine, and six impenetrable tires. The Hellhound's windshields are bulletproof armor-plated with screens affixed on the inside – the latest in CrystalDome technology. Your enemy never knows how many people are inside, whereas you can see the outside clear as day. When descending into the pits of hell, this beast truly is man's best friend.

title: Mizutani Hozuki
text: The Mizutani is the true definition of a sports car - fast, responsive and aggressive. The sight of the Shion's hood was the last sight of many a careless pedestrian on the streets of Night City. The Mizutani's latest edition, the Hozuki, aims to spruce up the brand's image. The hatchback body and four seats are meant to be an incentive for parents and families to give this car a shot. But Mizutani wouldn't be itself if it didn't equip this seemingly family-oriented car with a 180-horsepower hybrid engine and adaptive suspension for quick cornering. Tell your kids to buckle up, then slam that pedal.

title: Villefort Deleon V400 Coupé
text:
If Villefort ever needed to be advertised, it might use "less is more" as a slogan to promote its coupé model. But Villefort is a household name across every state for its tasteful design, excellent performance and almost obscene driving comfort.

The V400 Coupé is a compact, two-door limousine, designed and manufactured for customers who rarely ride with anyone but themselves - not including their egos. Lastly, the impressive 390 horsepower engine and rear-wheel drive are an excellent trade-off for the car's reduced proportions.

title: Herrera Riptide GT2
text: Looks familiar? The 2077 Herrera Riptide GT2 is a faithful copy of the original model prior to the crisis that plunged the Italian carmaker into bankruptcy. Originally, the Riptide was a class-leading luxury sports car. Today, it's even sportier thanks to modern upgrades hidden under its neo-militaristic body, and even more luxurious. After all, this contemporary remake can only be bought by the brand's regular customer - those who purchased a Herrera Outlaw before. Thanks to clever marketing, both models are disappearing from showrooms with a speed comparable to that of the Riptide GT2 on the road. In other words - fast.

title: Alvarado V4FH Herman
text:
Station wagons rarely elicit a reaction other than a yawn - even from their owners. But not the Alvarado V4FH 570 Herman. Even more trunk capacity comes courtesy of a completely redesigned rear end. Combined with the famous elongated hood of the Alvarado model, Herman has acquired perfectly balanced proportions. The already iconic, now improved dual-torsion axle technology at the car's front can only give one hope that the station wagon will be less prone to failure and cheaper to maintain.

The fact is, this cruiser is better suited for longer trips than tedious maneuvering on city streets due to its increased weight. So if you urgently need to leave Night City with the whole family, the Alvarado Herman is the car for you.

title: Quadra Sport R-7
text: "Quadra" is a word that many sports car enthusiasts have tattooed on their chests and close to their hearts. The Sport R-7 was developed in the 2060s as an homage to fans of classic muscle cars. This car is both beefy and sculpted - its heavy neo-militaristic body moves around on a 480-horsepower engine and rear-wheel drive. Compared to the Quadra V-Tech, the R-7 model is less responsive, which is not to say slow, but is more spacious in exchange. The increased stability also makes it more approachable for less seasoned drivers - no need to fear breaking the world record of zero to a hundred when the light turns green.

title: Makigai Tanishi
text: This Makigai model looks best when covered in grime, so don't leave it catching dust in a garage. Its relatively small size allows the Tanishi to weave through Dogtown's car wrecks with ease, and the spring suspension and four-wheel drive add spice to every off-road adventure. Even a river of toxic sewage won't be able to shake you off the road - a solid ABS snorkel will keep that putrid water well away from the engine. Small, yet feisty - the Makigai Tanishi in a nutshell.

title: Chevillon Centurion 1000
text:
The interior of the Centurion 1000 is so spacious that its price should be in square feet. No wonder - Chevillon has always specialized in producing extra comfortable limousines that elite politicians and corporate execs like to be chauffered in.

The car's colossal size requires an equally colossal engine, in this case a CHOOH2 chugger based on the Emperor model, but cranked up to 1,000 horsepower. Those willing to buy a Centurion can choose between single or dual rear axle versions - only who'd want 4x4 when they can have 6x6 drive?

title: Thorton Mackinaw "Demiurge"
text: If you were afraid of monsters under your bed as a kid, rest assured - this converted Thorton Mackinaw monster truck would never fit. Not even in a standard-sized studio unit. This Mackinaw's gigantic engine compartment is packed with industrial turbines and a thick tangle of intake system parts and exhaust manifolds. The raised body is crowned by an open-air cabin with a massive rollbar and chimneys that would belong better in a coal-fired power plant - only less environmentally-friendly. Interestingly, this "Demiurge" variant retained the interior and engine of the original Mackinaw, but with its electronic muzzle removed it can reach more than 1,000 horsepower. Add to that two torsion axles and a double-damper suspension and you can start terrorizing the streets in no time.

title: Militech Behemoth MT-3
text: An armored car in the "Behemoth" class. In addition to reinforced armor and a more powerful engine, this custom-made, rare edition also boasts an enlarged transport space. Militech also made some modifications to this model's electronics, installing an autopilot function and ambient scanners, making it easier to move and fight in adverse conditions. The real icing on the cake? An automated combat turret, utilizing programmable ammunition.

title: Quadra Sport R-7 "Charon"
text: Low-riding, fast, ostentatious yet classy. The "Charon" zips around town like a cheetah in heat, keeping you pleasantly weighted down as you accelerate while the engine purrs at a relaxing 512 Hz. It can be a sensory experience, if you let it. The dark, elegant interior is calming and soothing, allowing you to speed through the roads in a meditative state. Whether you're lead-footing the gas through Night City's main arteries or the endless desert - it's good to haul ass in premium class, even if there's a company logo stamped on it. Charon Exotics has some extortionate, redundant services, but this sure as hell ain't one of them. If anyone knew that, it was the Cassel twins.

title: Quadra Sport R-7 "Sterling"
text:
Was that a surfer just now, riding atop a silvery wave? No, that was the Quadra Sport R-7 "Sterling" shredding Night City's litter-covered streets and splashing its residents with sewage and oil-slicked rainwater. Gnarly, choom.

Mr. Hands is well aware there's no such thing as a second impression - only the first. That's why he chose a silver paint called "Mercury Swell" for this custom Quadra. "Silver, not gold?" you might be asking. Please... Mr. Hands doesn't do "kitsch." He bucks convention and, of course, only treasures products of the finest quality. No wonder, then, that his model of choice was the Sport R-7.

Mr. Hands' reputation may precede him, but his Quadra "Sterling" precedes all else.

title: Techtronika Metel
text: Cheap, ugly, but effective. If you're given a choice between a Metel and nothing at all, it may seem like a tough decision, but the Metel is the right call. It's most popular in slums and amongst those who put their faith in their skills, not their hardware. It can inflict some serious damage in the right hands, so if you like challenges and have a fondness for junk, this revolver from Techtronika is for you.

title: Fang
text: The shape resembles Paleolithic knives made from splintered bones. Perfect for both wood carving and… flaying. Crude, yet devilishly dangerous - the perfect weapon in the hands of a skilled combatant.

title: Nokota Osprey
text: A large-caliber, well-balanced rifle coveted by pros and wannabes alike. This hardware sells for top-shelf prices, but because it's a weapon of choice within multiple agencies, there's little doubt it's worth every enny. Once you get your hands on one, everything else will feel like clunky scrap metal by comparison.

title: Erebus
text:
A prototype weapon built from secret schematics and stamped with the logo of Project Cynosure. Its mere existence is an affront to international humanitarian law, though the engineers responsible for bringing Erebus to life already had worse things weighing on their conscience. The fruits of their labor resulted in a weapon that uses artificial intelligence to hack the combat cyberware of the targets it shoots.

The marriage of its tremendous firepower and its ability to fire a large number of projectiles means Erebus can wipe out an entire battalion entirely on its own. What's more, the modified frame makes handling this weapon terrifyingly simple – as if harnessing the power of AI to take down injured enemies wasn't enough already.

Don't let NetWatch catch you with your finger on its trigger.

title: Hercules 3AX
text: A prototype model based one of Militech's smart automatic rifles. What more could you want from a weapon spitting homing rounds without needing a Smart Link? Poison rounds, obviously. To turn an enemy into Swiss cheese is child's play, but to turn them into a bullet-ridden, steaming pile of liquified remains... that's a job for Hercules 3AX. 10/10 for style, 2/10 eco-for friendliness.

title: Militech Ticon
text:
Haters will say it looks antique, connoiseurs will claim it's a classic. Thanks to its simple construction, it rarely jams and is unlikely to fail you when you need it most. Its compact size guarantees it can remain hidden when tucked away behind your belt, which frankly makes it the ideal ally in heated arguments or when uninvited guests come knocking on your door.
The best thing about it? It just works.

title: HA-7 Warden
text: A surprisingly unique firearm clearly inspired by Arasaka's Shingen. Its powerful rapid fire comes with a heavy recoil, but eventually you'll find a mutual rhythm to your shots. Could this gun be the one you've been looking for all your life? Many would say so, despite the initial negative attitude towards its crude appearance. But what starts out as an oddity often ends up becoming a classic - especially when it's effective, and when it comes to the HA-7 Warden, there's no debate. You're sure to create many beautiful memories together.

title: HA-4 Grit
text:
Produced from an amalgamation of various Militech weapon parts by Hansen Armory. The ideal compromise between quality and price - a weapon that won't fail during a firefight, nor drain your wallet.

Its short, compact barrel allows you to fire a quick and deadly salvo from the hip, while the long magazine lends the gun a balanced feel. With the HA-4 Grit, you can confidently leap into action.

title: Tsunami Rasetsu
text: A Tech sniper rifle made by the renowned Tsunami. Its retrofuturistic design is a nod toward the original prototype of the series, which unfortunately never went into production. The revolutionary technology that allows you to reabsorb a portion of recoil energy and transfer it to the next shot is undoubtedly genius, but will burn a bigger hole in your pocket. Still, should you scrounge up the eddies and decide to buy, the Rasetsu will reward you with a lifetime of companionship.

title: Militech Canto Mk.6
text: The Canto Mk.6 is a deck that many netrunners and collectors consider an urban legend. A powerful Militech deck backed by the computing power of AI algorithms that was never mass-produced, using technologies that have yet to see the light of day - too good to be true? Maybe, especially since several models that appeared on illegal auctions turned out to be cleverly tweaked fakes of other Militech decks every time. And yet experts believe that the Canto Mk.6 exists, or rather: there was a very limited series of components that never made it into the wider market. The trick is to find these components - probably pilfer them from Militech's warehouses or buy them for heaps of eddies on the black market - and try to construct the Canto from them. Only then will the legend come to life....

title: Voodoo Boys in Dogtown
text:
Some say the Voodoo Boys of Dogtown live closer to the "edge" than their brothers and sisters in Pacifica. They take more risks and rarely look back, explore the dark corners of the net more often and end up earning more, too. In a way, the boundary between Pacifica and Dogtown is also the boundary between idealists and pragmatists.

Pragmatic Dogtown netrunners do business in the Stadium, lend others their services, run shady biz and protect the data of Hansen's guests, covering their tracks through the district's subnets. In other words, they keep the deluge of ones and zeros leaking out from Dogtown. From time to time, this symbiotic relationship between BARGHEST and the Voodoo Boys can seem shaky. So far, however, Hansen managed to ensure it's a little rumble here and there and not a full-blown earthquake.

title: Scavs in Dogtown
text:
Dogtown scavs are much better organized and equipped than their Night City brethren. They're no longer a Pan-Slavic horde of itchy triggers looking for a quick-'n'-dirty brawl, a strong stim and an easy eurobuck. Rumor has it those ones in Dogtown are linked to Soviet intelligence. True or false? Hard to tell. What's known is that whoever is spreading these rumors runs the risk of getting their picture stapled to the Memorial Tree in the Stacks.

The Dogtown scavs have cash, good equipment and a bit of disdain for their poorer NC kind. Why? Because only those without a knack for business end up in Night City. The scav oligarchy secures business in Hansen's backyard. So why would Hansen tolerate them? Simple. It's all about the money.

title: BARGHEST
text:
If you hear "Dogtown" and automatically think "BARGHEST," chances are you won't die straight away. The organization founded by Kurt Hansen is more than just an ordinary Night City gang. No one else has managed the feat of carving an entire district out for themselves, kicking out the police completely and keeping it that way for nearly a decade.
It started small: Colonel Hansen's unit seized part of Pacifica at the end of the Unification War and never laid down arms. Only six soldiers remain from that squad, and as Hansen's most trusted men they now sit at the top of the food chain. The nascent BARGHEST quickly took similar folks under its wing: veterans who'd been forgotten by the megacorps, mercs without contracts, renegade gangers from various parts of the city - you name it.

Hansen's organization also proved tempting to average Night City residents who, for various reasons, found themselves at the end of their ropes. Kurt Hansen gave them a gun, a salary, medical care via his ripper contacts and - perhaps most importantly - asked no questions in exchange for their absolute loyalty. For those at the very bottom, BARGHEST is a pretty good alternative to a life of petty crime - a career with a short life expectancy.
Anywhere else, under different leadership, the band of delinquents that make up BARGHEST would have collapsed like a house of cards or atrophied like a cyberpsycho's brain. Hansen managed the impossible. Credit goes to his dominating presence, charisma and intelligence, but most of all presenting folks with a fresh start - one without hidden costs or corporate fine print, and a place where cops and undercover narcs get strung up from lampposts. For many, this vision was, is and will continue to be extremely tempting.

title: New United States of America
text:
The official beginning of the New United States of America is marked by the ratification of the country's constitution, which took place on July 4, 2053. It was then that Elisabeth Kress, having ruled the country for 35 years, handed over power to an interim government in preparation for elections. Rosalind Myers was the third person in the presidential seat and also the second woman to hold the post. She began her first term in office by presenting a unification program to fulfill the age-old ambition of the federalist NUSA government - to reunite all the states. The separatist territories were, of course, reluctant to return under the star-spangled banner, which led to the outbreak of the Unification War in 2069. The conflict ended with the signing of the Treaty of Unification, which guaranteed that the Free States would retain their autonomy on the condition that they join the new federal government.

The center of NUSA power resides in the megacities to the northeast of the country, referred to collectively as the Plex and covering areas from Boston in the north to Washington in the south. President Rosalind Myers' third - which doesn't mean last - term in office is now coming to an end. Although the country's official political system remains a democracy, the continued dominance of one party (the Federalist Party) since the 2050s and strict national security restrictions make NUSA more like an authoritarian-run police state in reality.

title: BARGHEST Broadcast Station
text:
The loudspeakers appeared in Dogtown in the first weeks after the war as the freshly-bombarded neighborhood was rising from the rubble. While chaos ruled the streets, Kurt Hansen looked for a way to quickly regroup and organize. When his soldiers found an abandoned radio station in one of the ruined buildings, the problem solved itself. From then on, every day in Dogtown began and ended with a broadcasted speech, informing residents of new directives, orders and reconstruction progress.
The solution, meant to be initially temporary, worked so well that the loudspeakers remain in the neighborhood to this day, emitting words from their leader, Colonel Kurt Hansen. "Kurt FM" - as it is jokingly called by residents - can also be caught on shortwave. On it, one an hear announcements about generator deliveries to to the hospital, Hansen's soldierly reminiscing on the anniversary of Dogtown's occupation, and when the colonel is in a particularly good mood - Balkan folk hits. And even if some might cringe as they listen, it's hard to deny that BARGHEST's broadcasting is part of the neighborhood's identity.

title: Corp-Bud
text:
In 2013, an enterprising central european immigrant couple, Franz and Tonya Yanovsky, founded the family construction and renovation company Pol-Bud in Sacramento. Thanks to its competitive pricing and low-cost labor, as well as an economic boost after the Fourth Corporate War, the company's revenue grew steadily. The opening of its own cement factory in 2030 sealed Pol-Bud's status as a leader in the construction industry.
In 2048, the corporation's new CEO, Yan Yanovsky (Franz's oldest son), decided to rename the company Corp-Bud and make it independent of the global supply chain. By investing in his own fleet of dredge ships, he ensured Corp-Bud's continued access to the most valuable raw materials in the construction sector - sand.
Since then, the Corp-Bud logo has become a common sight in the North American landscape. While the corporation was building highways, shipyards, bridges and skyscrapers at an express pace, the ships sucking in hundreds of thousands of tons of sand gradually helped change the direction of ocean currents. When Mexico's Guadalupe Island vanished underwater as a result, Corp-Bud's good fortune came to an end.
Today the corporation is facing huge image and financial problems. The multibillion-dollar compensation it must pay to refugees from flooded areas is only a drop in the ocean of the developer's problems. Indeed, the North American Environmental Protection Agency has threatened to sink the corporation's fleet if Corp-Bud does not stop the predatory extraction of sand from the Pacific seabed.

title: SovOil
text: The largest and wealthiest Soviet corporation with an iron grip on the petrochemical industry. SovOil has been using its vast resources to manipulate the Soviet government for decades. There is no shortage of claims that SovOil holds the real power in the USSR. The corporation operates worldwide, but its main markets are Europe and Asia. It is less popular in North America, though it has branches in Washington and Night City. SovOil continues to focus mainly on oil production and sales, but is also becoming increasingly bolder in the CHOOH2 and experimental fuels markets.

title: Airdrops
text: The skies above Dogtown never sleep. Every now and then, AVs fly into its airspace and drop gifts for BARGHEST. Who sends the airdrops to Dogtown? It's a mystery. What's in the airdrops? Also a mystery. Want to unravel it? Take a look inside and try to survive.

title: AUTOFIXER
text:
Bored with your old ride? Starting a car collection? Easy! Just buy another! No one's stopping you so long as you have the eddies. Certainly not Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes, your trusted car dealer in Night City who has taken his business to the Net.

AUTOFIXER is the latest addition to Muamar's thriving fixer enterprise. Finding a niche in the market is the mark of a modern businessman. On the AUTOFIXER netdomain, you can browse all vehicles currently available for purchase, view photos and read up on the detes. Prices are non-negotiable, but when you buy from El Cap you can be sure that you're paying for quality and reliability.

title: Orbital Air
text:
Orbital Air was founded in Nairobi, Kenya, at the beginning of the 21st century - it is the oldest corporation specializing in the transportation of cargo and passengers via the Earth's orbit. OA's fleet consists of heavy-lift rockets, manned and unmanned spacecraft and commercial passenger shuttles. The Kenyan giant controls most of the world's spaceports, including the largest cosmodrome in Mogadishu.
Orbital Air's extensive portfolio of services additionally includes the construction and maintenance of orbital stations and satellite networks. The corporation also operates points of so-called "rocketless spaceships", using electromagnetic catapults (mass drivers). Because of this, Orbital Air has managed to significantly reduce the cost of launching cargo into low Earth orbit and secure a dominant position in the space industry.
Orbital Air remains the undisputed leader in innovative orbital technologies. Under its current CEO, Leslie Wawuda, the corporation pours immeasurable resources into space exploration/conquest. Currently, in cooperation with the New African authorities, the corporation is conducting research on the Alpha Centauri system.
Orbital Air's main competitors are the European Space Council (ESC), which established the first city on the moon, Tycho, in 1997; they also frequently collaborated with Night Corporation.
Indeed, Orbital Air and Miriam Night's corporation weren't always at each other's throats. The cold war between the two colossi began around 2045 when the Kenyan corp took over a mass driver build site in Night City, which was left unfinished. As a result, Night Corp irrevocably lost the chance to have their home city be the frontier for conquering the great beyond of space.

title: FIA
text:
The Federal Intelligence Agency was established in 2006 after the dissolution of the NSA (National Security Agency) and the CIA (Central Intelligence Agency), both of which were implicated in organizing a conspiracy to overthrow the US government. In theory, it was supposed to take over and join their functions, but in practice it remained an underfunded institution of marginal importance for almost half a century.

This all changed after the ratification of the NUSA Constitution in 2053. The FIA was granted extensive powers and privileges, and a huge budget made it possible to recruit a veritable army of secret informants and equip them with state-of-the-art technology. Since 2065 when Rosalind Myers became the NUS president, the FIA has steadily grown in strength. The active participation of agents in the course of the Unification War has become an open secret. After the war ended, the FIA's involvement in direct military action was greatly reduced in favor of data acquisition and analysis.

FIA agents now conduct intelligence operations around the world, loyally and discreetly pursuing the NUSA's political objectives. The weekly reports that President Myers receives from the FIA's leadership provide her with invaluable knowledge of the plans and actions of foreign governments and multinational corporations, and even a few influential private individuals. Skeptics say that the FIA serves Myers mainly as a secret weapon in her political games against Militech. The reality? Only the FIA knows.

title: Crimson Harvest
text:
An anti-corporate organization focused on fighting Biotechnica. Initially, it comprised mostly farmers and agricultural entrepreneurs in North America. Members of Crimson Harvest demanded Biotechnica cease charging annual fees for crop licenses, an extortion scheme that was depleting the budgets of small farms and forcing farmers to sell off their land, tranche by tranche, to the corporation.
In response to peaceful protests, Biotechnica not only increased its prices, but also, if the rumors are to be believed, unleashed a virus that decimated all crops grown from grain not sourced from its corporate labs.
The helpless farmers filled the ranks of Crimson Harvest en masse and as the organization grew, they began protesting in an acceleratingly radical manner. Biotechnica employees regularly fell victim to assaults, beatings or even murder; the bloodiest incident occurred in a research facility in Paris. In its aftermath, being a member of Crimson Harvest was outlawed by the authorities of all American countries and was officially recognized as a terrorist organization.
Some existing supporters of Crimson Harvest - unnerved by the violent and downright cruel direction the organization has taken - packed up and left. Their place was soon taken over by anti-corporate fanatics, for whom fighting for farmer's rights became an excuse to burn, kill and sew mayhem. Despite Biotechnica's efforts, most Crimson Harvest members remain elusive and at large.

title: Cerberus
text: The maintenance robot "Cerberus" produced by Militech is one of the most advanced units of its kind. For a long time it remained in the prototype stage - Militech was very reluctant to publicize information about it, nor did it grant any external licenses or sell any models. The robot served only in Militech's research and technology facilities. Some models were equipped with practically indestructible armor and subsystems that allowed AI to work in tandem with the machine - in this respect, "Cerberus" was a technological marvel. These special versions of the robot were able to operate in the most extreme conditions, disregarding the dangers of radiation or electromagnetic discharge. Thanks to this, they were able to operate and maintain the cores at Militech's technological facilities, including those on the Moon.
